title: Anthropic was last at $87.28. That was not the close.
friendlyTitle: Anthropic's shares were last at $87.28. That was not the final price.
summary: Reuters reported that during Friday's session Anthropic was last trading at $87.28, about 10 percent below Thursday's close and not far from the $83 IPO price. At that print, Reuters put the fully diluted valuation at about $1.6 trillion, and the market value of shares outstanding at $1.2 trillion.
friendlySummary: Reuters reported that during Friday's trading Anthropic shares were last at $87.28. That is about 10 percent below Thursday's close, and close to the $83 price set before trading began. At that moment, Reuters put the full value, counting every share and option, at about $1.6 trillion. The value of shares already issued was $1.2 trillion.
whyItMatters: Reuters also says the offering raised $93.5 billion after underwriters bought extra shares, and that Morgan Stanley has closed the position meant to steady the stock. A figure taken during the session is not the closing price, and it does not change what you pay for Claude.
